messages.subject: Thoughts on what this is called?
parts: What capability is it called of a computer program that can adjust parameters and weightings based on results and then re-execute itself (using the same or new data but the new adjustments) & then determine if the new result is better or more in line of what is viewed? This same program can also access a library of other functions for additional processing to get even better results...
